title: Adopt the App Template baseline
summary: Marks a repository as sitting on the App Template 2026.07.31.1 baseline. A freshly scaffolded project already ships the marker, so this task is a no-op there — it exists so the task index has a first entry to anchor every later task's dependsOn/minTemplateVersion chain, and so a repo that lost (or never had) .app-template-version.json can be brought back onto the baseline without guessing. Applying it creates the adoption marker only; it changes no application code.
